scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:pos && npm run test:bridge
scripts.test:api: for f in api/__tests__/*.test.mjs; do echo "— $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:pos: for f in pos/__tests__/*.test.cjs; do echo "— $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:browser: echo 'needs: npm run pos:build, then npm run serve in another shell' && for f in pos/__tests__/*.test.mjs; do echo "— $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
